title: Mediterranean Blue Contemporary Freestanding Countertop Paper Towel Holder Valet, 14-Inch Tall, Solid Brass Weighted Base, Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep paper towels within easy reach without a flimsy stand sliding around your counter—this freestanding valet stays put — available in Mediterranean Blue that which presents a deep, sophisticated blue with subtle purple undertones, evoking the rich depths of coastal waters for a bold yet refined statement. Backed by a limited lifetime warranty and crafted from solid brass for everyday kitchen use.

  • Mediterranean Blue transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your kitchen
  • Keeps islands and prep areas tidy with a clean, freestanding footprint (no wall mounting required)
  • Designed to resist corrosion and rust for lasting performance

Why solid brass? Solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives in busy kitchens.

Specs
- Product type: Countertop paper towel holder / paper towel valet
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 5 in x 14 in x 5 in
- Mounting: Freestanding (no wall mounting)
- Material: Brass (solid brass construction)
- Product weight: 4.8 lb
- Included items: Paper towel holder
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty

Complete your kitchen with coordinating pieces in matching finishes.
meta_description: Freestanding countertop paper towel holder, 14-inch tall solid brass stand with weighted base and felt pad. Contemporary style, limited lifetime warranty.
